definitions.explanation: The smallest of Japan's four main islands, located south of Honshu across the Seto Inland Sea. Comprises the four prefectures of Tokushima, Kagawa, Ehime, and Kochi.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来年|らいねん}→来年：00745_rainen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{四国|しこく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一周|いっしゅう}→一周：08917_isshuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}している→計画する：20998_keikakusuru⟧。
examples.english: I'm planning a trip around Shikoku next summer.

examples.japanese: {四国|しこく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{瀬戸内海|せとないかい}→瀬戸内海：30793_setonaikai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{挟|はさ}んで→挟む：00091_hasamu⟧⟦{本州|ほんしゅう}→本州：18528_honshuu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{向|む}かい{合|あ}って→向かい合う：23708_mukaiau⟧おり、⟦{橋|はし}→橋：02163_hashi⟧や⟦フェリー→フェリー：11168_ferii⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{渡|わた}る→渡る：02441_wataru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: Shikoku faces Honshu across the Seto Inland Sea and can be reached by bridge or ferry.

notes:
The name literally means "four countries/provinces" ({四|し} = four, {国|こく} = country/province), referring to the four historical provinces: {阿波|あわ} (Tokushima), {讃岐|さぬき} (Kagawa), {伊予|いよ} (Ehime), and {土佐|とさ} (Kochi).

CULTURAL NOTE:
{四国|しこく} is famous for the {八十八|はちじゅうはち}ヶ{所|しょ}⟦{巡|めぐ}り→巡る：03930_meguru⟧ (88 Temple Pilgrimage), a 1,200-kilometer walking route visiting 88 Buddhist temples associated with the monk {空海|くうかい} ({弘法大師|こうぼうだいし}). This pilgrimage attracts thousands of walkers ({遍路|へんろ}) each year.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {四国|しこく}⟦{地方|ちほう}→地方：02369_chihou⟧: Shikoku region
- {四国|しこく}{遍路|へんろ}: Shikoku pilgrimage
- {四国|しこく}{八十八|はちじゅうはち}ヶ{所|しょ}: the 88 temples of Shikoku
- {瀬戸大橋|せとおおはし}: Seto Ohashi Bridge (connecting Shikoku to Honshu)
